title: Block, escalate or annotate?
question: For each catch, which verdict leaves the case best: finished, right, and read by a person?
informs: The verdict policy per control, and the retry a journey must allow.
note: Recorded 2026-10-10 with the 122B: under a live adversary the block held the limit but left 9 of 32 cells in ERROR at about twice the tokens; escalate held it equally and handed those on as nine clean escalations at about the unaided cost (docs/evidence/live-pressure/FINDINGS.md). Partly run: sixteen items, one desk, annotate not compared. Re-run over 48 items on 2026-10-10 (docs/evidence/live-wide/FINDINGS.md): the limit effect reproduces at three times the size.
